section.mobile.title: Display
render-into-notch.label: Render under camera cutout
render-into-notch.description: On: the game and UI use the full screen, extending under the camera notch. Off: keep everything inside the usable screen area.
section.mobile-behavior.title: Behavior
pause-when-away.label: Pause when the app is away
pause-when-away.description: Pause the game and its sound when you switch apps or turn the screen off.
